questions.prompt: Why must a human review checklist exist alongside ShellCheck?

options.a: Critical high-severity flaws (trust boundaries, input validation, intent) are invisible to a static linter
options.c: Human checklists take less time to execute

questions.prompt: What risk is introduced by running ShellCheck first during a human code review pass?

options.a: Anchoring the reviewer on linter findings, causing them to overlook invisible logic flaws
options.c: Causing ShellCheck to output false positives

questions.prompt: How does a blocking checklist item differ from an advisory checklist item?

options.a: A failing blocking item prevents the script from shipping to production
options.b: Advisory items are strictly optional to read
options.c: Blocking items are checked by CI tools while advisory items are not
